item.title: Red Flag Warning For Central Missouri
item.description: A RED FLAG warning is issued for central Missouri counties, including Carroll and Chariton Counties in the local area. The National Weather Service issued the Red Flag Warning from Noon to 8:00 pm due to low relative humidity and gusty winds. The National Weather Service says any fire that develops will catch and spread quickly. […]

item.title: Salisbury Awarded $70,000 Grant From Missouri DNR
item.description: The Missouri Department of Natural Resources’ Drinking Water Emerging Contaminant Grant program has awarded $70,000 to the community of Salisbury to evaluate the city’s drinking water system. The program helps communities to assess their systems and identify improvements to address emerging contaminants in the drinking water. item.title: Livingston County Jail Booking
item.description: The Livingston County Sheriff’s Department reported two recent jail bookings. 34-year-old Chelsea Ann Roller of Trenton was booked on an alleged probation violation and is held with no bond allowed as she awaits extradition. 29-year-old Reed James Fuller was booked by Caldwell County deputies for alleged DWI. Bond is set at $5,000 cash only..

item.title: Keithley Appointed To Health Center Board Of Trustees
item.description: The appointment for the Livingston County Health Center Board of Trustees was approved by the Livingston County commissioners on Thursday morning. Presiding Commissioner Ed Douglas made the announcement. Betsy Keithley was selected. Keithley is expected to be sworn in at next Tuesday’s Health Center Board meeting
